name: Indoor inspection drone Drone-01
description: Showcase example: an indoor inspection drone whose mission supervisor is a verified Digital Twin. The twin plans over partial building knowledge, learns the building through the environment API, replans when new information invalidates its route, and records every semantic decision in a tamper-evident ledger.
